dialogues.en: I stretched out my hand to look for the alarm clock.
dialogues.text: I stretched out my hand to look for the alarm clock.

dialogues.jp: 手を伸ばし、目覚ましのスイッチを探る。

dialogues.en: I woke up a little after I stopped the alarm.
dialogues.text: I woke up a little after I stopped the alarm.

dialogues.en:
Nemu left yesterday, so it's back to using the alarm
clock......
dialogues.text:
Nemu left yesterday, so it's back to using the alarm
clock......

dialogues.jp:
目覚ましを止めてから３テンポほど遅れて、上
半身を起こす。
dialogues.en: "......Nemu looked very vibrant."
dialogues.text: "......Nemu looked very vibrant."

dialogues.jp:
昨日、音夢が帰ったので、今日からまた目覚ま
しのお世話になるのか……。
dialogues.en:
I know she's not alone in the dorm, but I was worried about
her. I'm relieved to know that she's doing fine.
dialogues.text:
I know she's not alone in the dorm, but I was worried about
her. I'm relieved to know that she's doing fine.

dialogues.jp:
「そういえば、音夢のやつすごく元気になって
　たな」
dialogues.en: "Perhaps she's allergic to pollen."
dialogues.text: "Perhaps she's allergic to pollen."

dialogues.jp:
寮に居るからひとりじゃないのだろうが、やは
り心配ではあったのでひと安心だ。
dialogues.en: I muttered a silly joke.
dialogues.text: I muttered a silly joke.

dialogues.jp: 「あいつ、花粉症だったんじゃないか？」
dialogues.en: I stretched my body and looked outside the window.
dialogues.text: I stretched my body and looked outside the window.

dialogues.jp: 冗談にもならない冗談を呟く。
dialogues.en: Nemu's gone, and Sakura won't appear at this window again.
dialogues.text: Nemu's gone, and Sakura won't appear at this window again.

dialogues.jp: う〜ん、と背伸びをして窓の外を見つめた。
dialogues.en: To be honest -- I feel sad.
dialogues.text: To be honest -- I feel sad.

dialogues.jp:
音夢もいなくなり、さくらも、もうこの窓から
現れることはない。
寂しいといえば――正直に寂しい。
dialogues.en: The cherry blossom branches were swinging outside.
dialogues.text: The cherry blossom branches were swinging outside.

dialogues.en: "......Something feels strange......"
dialogues.text: "......Something feels strange......"

dialogues.jp: 外で桜の枝が揺れている。
dialogues.en:
I felt like something was wired into my head, as if a fish
bone was stuck in my throat.
dialogues.text:
I felt like something was wired into my head, as if a fish
bone was stuck in my throat.

dialogues.jp: 「……そういえば、なんか変だな？」
dialogues.en:
My environment's changing, and everything seems to be
happening at the same time.
dialogues.text:
My environment's changing, and everything seems to be
happening at the same time.

dialogues.jp:
喉にはりついた魚の骨のように、頭の片隅に何
かが引っかかっている。
dialogues.en: The never-dying cherry blossom died.
dialogues.text: The never-dying cherry blossom died.

dialogues.jp:
周囲の環境が変化してはいるのだが、どうにも
時期が重なりすぎているのではないか？
dialogues.en: Nemu and Sakura left the island.
dialogues.text: Nemu and Sakura left the island.

dialogues.jp: 枯れないはずの桜が枯れたこと。
dialogues.en: I stopped dreaming......
dialogues.text: I stopped dreaming......

dialogues.jp: 音夢の体調と、さくらの別れ。
dialogues.en: "Oh...... what about this?"
dialogues.text: "Oh...... what about this?"

dialogues.jp: 俺が他人の夢を見なくなったことと――。
dialogues.en:
For the first time in a long while, I imagined a simple rice
cake in my head.
dialogues.text:
For the first time in a long while, I imagined a simple rice
cake in my head.

dialogues.jp: そして――

萌先輩が急によそよそしくなり、やめていた栄
養剤を再び飲み始めたこと――
dialogues.en: It should come out.
dialogues.text: It should come out.

dialogues.jp:
（もしかすると、見えないところですべて因果
　関係が繋がっているんだろうか……？）
dialogues.en:
I was able to make the sweets come out of my hand while
chatting with people.
dialogues.text:
I was able to make the sweets come out of my hand while
chatting with people.

dialogues.jp:
他愛のない空想だったが、なぜかその考えが心
のどこかにひっそりとわだかまっていた。
dialogues.en: I haven't used this power in a while......
dialogues.text: I haven't used this power in a while......

dialogues.jp: ◆重なった変化◆
dialogues.en: ◆The power of Japanese sweets◆
dialogues.text: ◆The power of Japanese sweets◆

dialogues.jp: 枯れないはずの桜が枯れて。
dialogues.en:
I tried to make Japanese sweets come out of my hands but I
realized I couldn't do that any more.
dialogues.text:
I tried to make Japanese sweets come out of my hands but I
realized I couldn't do that any more.

dialogues.jp: 音夢の体調と、さくらの別れ。
dialogues.en: My power disappeared as if it was a dream.
dialogues.text: My power disappeared as if it was a dream.

dialogues.jp: 俺が他人の夢を見なくなったことと――。
そして――萌先輩の変化――。
全てが重なっているように、思った……。
